name: held-text-names-files-as-paths
description: Held text names a file only where one of its names appears as a path in a word: a word of a workflow comment, a path a comment writes, a job key, the word a command echoes, a name inside a longer word and the action a step uses hold nothing, because no comment and no key is read, so the test-only export of the file a comment names only by a word is reported and its directive is in effect, and the unused exports of the files a comment's path, a job key, a longer word and an action reference spell are reported. A file a step's env value names by its path is held, so the directive on its test-only export is dormant, not stale.
